steps.title: Observe bounded waiting

steps.title: Clean owned resources
steps.explanation: Always release the handler and close the server, including failed assertions.

dns-cache.title: An exact TTL boundary requires fresh resolution
dns-cache.summary: Offline injected-clock model only; no DNS query or connection migration is demonstrated.

validators.title: 304 reuses an existing representation
validators.summary: The fixed ETag is an immutable sample teaching constant; 304 does not send a new lesson body.

nodes.label: Initial GET
nodes.description: Client requests the lesson without a cached body.

nodes.label: 200 + body + ETag
nodes.description: Store a suitable representation with validator lesson-v1.

nodes.label: Conditional GET
nodes.description: Send If-None-Match using that stored validator.

nodes.label: 304 without body
nodes.description: The matching validator says the stored representation may be reused under the contract.

nodes.label: Reuse stored lesson
nodes.description: Do not parse the empty 304 content as a new JSON body.

nodes.label: Missing cached body
nodes.description: Unexpected 304 without suitable local content requires recovery with an appropriate unconditional request.

steps.title: Acquire representation and validator
steps.explanation: The body is needed later; an ETag alone is insufficient.

steps.title: Validate conditionally
steps.explanation: The conditional request receives 304 and no new lesson body.

steps.title: Choose reuse or recovery
steps.explanation: Use the suitable stored body; otherwise recover under the application request policy.

redirects.title: Reapply policy at every redirect hop
redirects.summary: The lab observes 307 with Location /lesson without automatically following it.

nodes.description: Begin with an allowed destination.

nodes.description: Record the redirect itself; method is preserved when following 307.

nodes.label: Resolve and validate next target
nodes.description: Check hop count, destination origin and credential-forwarding policy again.

nodes.label: Follow allowed target or stop
nodes.description: Reject loops/out-of-policy destinations; an allowed first target does not approve every later Location.

body-contracts.title: Validate more than HTTP success
body-contracts.summary: The decoder accepts only the declared lesson observation; malformed 200 responses remain failures.

nodes.label: HTTP response received
nodes.description: A 200 status alone is insufficient application evidence.

nodes.label: Bound body and media type
nodes.description: Require intended JSON media type and the 4096-byte teaching limit.

nodes.label: Decode JSON syntax
nodes.description: Malformed JSON or decoding failure raises ProtocolError.

nodes.label: Validate exact schema
nodes.description: Require object fields lesson:string and version:exact integer; boolean version is rejected.

nodes.label: Publish validated observation
nodes.description: Every rejected stage must prevent publishing a lesson; streaming extensions enforce size during reading.

retry-budgets.title: Check attempt and time budgets before dispatch
retry-budgets.summary: The injected-clock GET helper is a policy model; callbacks need their own transport timeout and this helper has no backoff or jitter.

nodes.label: Before next GET
nodes.description: Track total attempts including the first.

nodes.label: Attempts and deadline remain
nodes.description: Check the injected overall deadline before dispatch.

nodes.label: Invoke bounded callback
nodes.description: The helper cannot preempt a blocked callback.

nodes.label: Response status
nodes.description: Selected gateway/unavailable failures can lead to another attempt.

nodes.label: Return final result / stop
nodes.description: Exhausted deadline starts zero new calls; three failures stop after three calls.

steps.title: Bound new dispatch
steps.explanation: Three attempts means at most three calls, not three retries after the first.

steps.title: Bound each callback separately
steps.explanation: The overall helper deadline cannot interrupt an unbounded transport callback.

steps.title: Account for added load
steps.explanation: 503 then 200 succeeds on attempt two; coordinated retry ownership prevents multiplied deepest calls.

cookies.title: Synthetic cookie issuance and replay
cookies.summary: This fixed, forgeable token demonstrates headers, not authenticated accounts.
